purpose: Upload and verify exactly the 119 pinned keys (raw 58, derived v2 61). No other key, bucket or operation.
job_caps_note: All runs of this job together, including the usage recorded before the ledger existed (ledger seq 1), admissions of runs that never settled, and room kept for this month's remaining admissions (20 x the admission limits). Sized for one upload run and two full verification rounds. Pinned bytes: raw 84,672,102 + derived 19,611,663 = 104,283,765.
run_profiles_note: Each profile must pay for its admission (admission limits), reservation and settlement (tail read and the worst case of the settlement write); load_job checks this. A run reserves its profile in full; when it settles only the measured use counts (never more than reserved). A run that never settles keeps its admission and its whole reservation.
